adaptation.loss: mean softmax conditional entropy on retained target samples only
adaptation.trainable: all model.parameters(), identical scope to no_pseudo_fixed; inactive parameters remain naturally without gradient
adaptation.bn_stats: track_running_stats=True; support train BN batch normalization and running statistics update momentum=0.10; query eval uses terminal running statistics
adaptation.dropout: train support / eval query; same seed rule as existing baseline
adaptation.gating_rule: same train-forward loss mask as absolute gate: retain 0.20 <= H <= 0.40 nats; full support batch still supplies BN statistics
adaptation.gate_threshold_selection: user-specified previous absolute thresholds, no scan

permissions.source_labels: none for adaptation; source/valid read only for existing split identity audit

decision.primary: 9-cell mean Macro-F1 >0.72; report >0.725 stretch and delta/NAR vs tent_bn separately
decision.report: all seed/date pairs and Macro-F1/NAR/recovery contrasts; no early stopping or tuning
decision.collapse_diagnostic: report finite logits, predicted unique classes and max predicted-class fraction; no query-based tuning
decision.selection: no tuning; terminal step800; no early stopping based on labels
decision.interpretation: joint recipe efficacy only; no isolated proof of branch mismatch or universality; no_pseudo_fixed uses source replay unlike this method

evaluation.protocol: target support-only adaptation, terminal tracked-BN query inference; no query statistics or updates
evaluation.query_order: existing query index order; no shuffle
evaluation.model_mode: support all modules train; BN momentum0.10; query eval
evaluation.control: 63 historical rows in 7 conditions, matched seed/date/query; no repeated training
evaluation.caveat: TENT-inspired full-parameter entropy adaptation, not original norm-only TENT; no source BN forward, so momentum matches baseline but BN trajectory differs

development_exposure.basis: user hypothesis based on previously observed TemporalDrift TENT and Proteus/no_pseudo outcomes; all thresholds and budget fixed before this run
development_exposure.dataset: TemporalDrift observed development data; not independent confirmation
